head.desc: A brown wooly hat that will even warm your ears. It's not old, it's vintage.

head.name: Merfolk dance circlet
head.desc: This silvery metal circlet has a beautiful gem right in the middle. It can manage to stay in place even with heavy currents dancing underwater.

head.name: Linden leaf hat
head.desc: Only the most reputable in Trellin own a leafy hat like this. There's even a branch of their famous regional grapes sticking out of it.

head.name: Forester's hat
head.desc: This green hat, inlaid with sheep's wool, is well-suited for winter weather.

head.name: Lumberjack hat
head.desc: The hat suited for woodcutting adventures.

cape.name: Cape of Achiever
cape.desc: The rose-coloured cape sparks interest in anyone who witnesses it. The owner of the cape has fulfilled what others only dream of.

cape.name: Cape of Half-Achiever
cape.desc: This magnificent blue cape represents someone filled with determination to achieve greatness.

cape.name: Proper cape
cape.desc: A stylish cape that adds a touch of elegance to your outfit, perfect for formal events or when you want to make a bold fashion statement.

back.desc: A backpack that is said to remember the journeys you been on. The more you explore, the more you seem to be able to fit inside of it!

back.name: Bag of rocks
back.desc: It's hard dragging this around, why are you doing this again?

chest.name: Proper shirt

chest.name: Merfolk dance corslet
chest.desc: Coordinated pieces of clothing for your torso to embody the dancing spirit of the merfolk.

chest.name: Linden leaf vest
chest.desc: Although a beefy bush costume, the leaves and branches are surprisingly comfortable. They can sometimes tickle your neck at worst.

chest.name: Forester's flannel shirt
chest.desc: This green flannel shirt is warm and comfortable. Well suited for working deep in nature.

chest.desc: The elderhide tunic is worn by gatherers who venture out to gather resources in challenging places.

chest.name: Grassknot tunic
chest.desc: A tunic improved by adding grass, an unlikely choice but surprisingly effective.

chest.name: Rootweave tunic
chest.desc: A tunic improved by adding roots to the fabric, making you look like a leafless bush.

hands.name: Tree scaling claws
hands.desc: Equipped with these special claws, no bird's nest will be out of reach.

hands.name: Merfolk dance bracers
hands.desc: Although traditionally used for merfolk dancing, these add to the flow of any activity.

hands.name: Linden leaf gloves
hands.desc: These gloves make your fingers feel like little twigs.

hands.name: Elderhide mitts
hands.desc: These mitts are assembled from the fabled elderhide, making them turn the eyes of other gatherers when you walk by.

hands.name: Grassknot mitts
hands.desc: Cloth mittens with interwoven grass strings, making them special.

hands.name: Rootweave mitts
hands.desc: These mittens, strengthened by the addition of roots, are surprisingly comfortable while adding protection for the fingers.

hands.name: Tatty handwraps
hands.desc: Tattered cloth hand wrappings, crafted by someone with questionable skill.

legs.name: Proper pants
legs.desc: You wouldn't want to get these stained, they're quite proper!

legs.desc: An old pair of jeans, one size too large for you. Fortunately comes with a leather belt, so it's not a problem.

legs.name: Merfolk dance skirt
legs.desc: This flowy skirt would be considered high fashion, even in surface communities.

legs.name: Linden leaf shorts
legs.desc: These leafy shorts make you feel like a bush. They're also quite impractical for protecting against scratches from twigs and tall grass.

legs.name: Forester's pants
legs.desc: These green pants are built to withstand scrapes and scratches from twigs and branches.

legs.name: Elderhide chaps
legs.desc: The chaps made from elderhide provide excellent protection from the elements.

legs.name: Grassknot chaps
legs.desc: Linen chaps interwoven with grass, designed to be worn over leggings.

legs.name: Rootweave chaps
legs.desc: Chaps reinforced with roots, providing protection for your legs while in the wild.

legs.name: Tatty skirt
legs.desc: A tattered cloth wrapping to cover yourself, easy to move around in, but the fabric makes your skin itch.

neck.name: Simple amulet
neck.desc: A brass coloured necklace with a similarly coloured pendant that has some lighter coloured nonsensical shapes on it.

neck.name: Amulet of bat
neck.desc: A shining amulet with the power of a bat.

feet.name: Boulder boots
feet.desc: Do you think these belonged to some kind of wrestler called "The Boulder" in addition to being made out of rocks?

feet.name: Proper boots
feet.desc: Sturdy and comfortable boots designed for both style and functionality. Whether you're strolling through Galeforge or trekking through the jungles of Rid Raddak, these boots have your feet covered.

tool.name: Greedy piggy bank
tool.desc: Each time a coin is dropped in, this golden piggy bank oinks loudly.

tool.name: Omni-tool
tool.desc: This tool, which can be attached to your forearm, is designed to assist with various tasks at your command.

pet.name: Pixie
pet.desc: A hyped up pixie, or is it a fairy? Quite ready for the party of a lifetime. You better be ready for anything.
pet.rareDesc: There's a saying that if you run across a party pixie, you better plan to not do anything the next day. Will you survive?

egg.name: Pixie egg
egg.desc: A pixie egg. Don't shake it at all or jolt it around! That goes without saying normally, but these cause problems for everyone around when that happens.

consumable.name: Cooked shark

consumable.name: Salmon pie
